PETRIFIED DEAD WOOD — blackened skeletal canopy locking out all warmth; foreground gnarled root-knuckles erupt through frost-cracked earth, pale lichen spreading like plague across bark; midground trunks wider than houses lean at broken angles, will-o-wisp clusters drifting between them in cold blue-green flame; deep distance a collapsed bell-tower swallowed by the treeline, a single amber window glowing impossibly within; sky absolute ink pierced by bone-pale stars.

VAST TOMBSTONE NECROPOLIS — cemetery stretching beyond sight in every direction; foreground cracked marble slabs tilted like broken teeth, black roses threading through mortar gaps; midground row upon row of mausoleums with corroded iron doors, fog pooling knee-deep between them; deep distance a cathedral silhouette rising from the grave-field's center, its spires vanishing into violet cloud; sky a silver-haloed moon casting every stone in cold funeral light, a distant crow-flock wheeling.

CLIFF-TOP FORTRESS APPROACH — mountain spur dropping a thousand feet to invisible mist; foreground loose shale and dead thistle edging the precipice, wind-scoured stone bearing claw-mark grooves of unknown origin; midground a ruined gatehouse straddling the ridge path, iron portcullis frozen half-raised; deep distance the main citadel clings to the peak, its black towers spearing low cloud, a single lit window burning amber against the dark; sky purple storm-wall advancing from the east.

DROWNED CHAPEL BOG — corpse-marsh at eternal twilight; foreground black water filming over submerged flagstones, dead rushes standing like needles, a cracked stone font half-sunk and filled with green stagnant rain; midground the drowned chapel's nave walls rising from the water, vaulted arches broken mid-span, will-o-wisps threading each arch like lanterns; deep distance dead-tree spires dissolve into silver-green fog; sky a low amber haze bleeding into violet, single bat silhouette crossing.

HEATHER MOOR WITH BARROW FIELD — wind-swept lowland under a bruised twilight; foreground heather crushed flat by ceaseless wind, gorse thorns catching scraps of burial cloth; midground a line of ancient barrows humped like sleeping creatures, each crowned with a single black standing stone; deep distance a ruined abbey's skeletal nave rises from the moor-edge, its rose-window a dark void framed in crumbling limestone; sky iron-grey cloud racing overhead, a lone wolf-silhouette pausing on the furthest barrow.

SEA-CLIFF WITH LIGHTHOUSE TOWER — storm-wracked coastal edge above a churning black ocean; foreground wet black rock slick with brine and dark kelp, tide-pools reflecting violet sky in broken mirrors; midground sheer basalt columns dropping hundreds of feet to white-foam devastation below; deep distance a lighthouse tower leans from the cliff-edge, its lantern replaced by green witch-fire casting sick light across the waves; sky roiling storm, violet lightning threading between towers of cumulonimbus.

FROZEN LAKE GOTHIC CHATEAU — winter stillness laid over black ice; foreground frost-cracked jetty planks dusted in snow, iron mooring rings rusted orange against white; midground the frozen lake spreading vast and mirror-flat, cracked in long fissures that glow faint blue beneath; deep distance a baroque chateau rises from the far shore, each mansard roof piled with snow, every window dark except two burning candle-amber on the third floor; sky moonlit silver-violet, a single crow crossing the ice-plain.

VOLCANIC ASH WASTELAND — smoldering obsidian plain beneath a choking grey sky; foreground cracked black basalt releasing thin ribbons of sulfur-steam, pale ash drifting like snow across collapsed stone columns; midground a city reduced to foundation-grid and broken walls, witch-fire vents exhaling fel-green flame from every fifth ruin; deep distance a volcanic cone dominates, its caldera glowing dull copper beneath ash-cloud; sky absolute grey-black with ember particles drifting upward like inverse snow.

CANYON GORGE WITH STONE AQUEDUCT — sheer red-black canyon dropping to invisible river below; foreground fractured stone parapet at canyon-lip, iron fence-posts rusted to nothing, dead vine curtaining the edge; midground the great aqueduct-bridge spanning the full chasm, its arches darkened by centuries of moisture, green moss tracing every joint; deep distance a cathedral ruin juts from the canyon wall far across, its apse built directly into the rock face; sky narrow slot of violet sky overhead, bat colony erupting from the canyon in a black river.

ABBEY RUIN UNDER FULL MOONLIGHT — collapsed nave open to weather and stars; foreground broken floor tiles scattered across overgrown moss, iron candelabra collapsed and half-buried; midground the abbey's remaining walls frame open sky like a roofless greenhouse, carved seraphim statues beheaded along every arcade, pale moonlight pooling in their hollow necks; deep distance a tower still standing with a single slit-window burning moonlit violet; sky enormous pale-silver moon directly overhead, its light architectural and merciless.

ALPINE PASS VAMPIRE CITADEL — mountain corridor between black-granite peaks; foreground ice-rimmed stone road cracked by centuries of frost-heave, dead pine trunks snapped and crossed like barricades; midground the pass narrows between sheer cliff faces, old iron chains strung between them bearing tattered black pennants; deep distance the castle erupts from the peak above, its silhouette impossible — too many towers, each leaning slightly inward; sky moonlit above the peaks but storm-black below them, a single distant light in the highest tower.

HALF-SUBMERGED MAUSOLEUM SWAMP — poisoned fen at blue-grey dusk; foreground black water carpeted in pale pond-weed, a marble hand emerging from the surface still gripping a carved rose; midground rows of above-ground crypts half-sunk at angles, iron crosses leaning, green moss consuming every inscription; deep distance a grand mausoleum palace sits on slightly higher ground, its columns intact but its dome collapsed inward, will-o-wisps crowning the ruin like displaced stars; sky flat pewter pressing down.

CURSED VILLAGE AERIAL — aerial descent over a haunted settlement at dusk; foreground clay-tile rooftops dark with rain, chimney-stacks cold and smokeless, iron weathervanes rusted still; midground the village grid of cobbled lanes converging on a black-stone church, its spire intact, its bell hanging crooked; deep distance rolling farmland gone to thistle and crow-black fields, and on the far hill a castle with lit windows watching everything; sky bruised copper-orange fading to violet at the zenith, crow-flock spiraling the church spire.

BLOOD-BARK GROVE — ancient forest of trees with dark crimson-veined bark; foreground surface roots like exposed tendons crossing a path of compressed black soil, fallen bark curled like old manuscript; midground trunks arch overhead forming a natural vault, red veins pulsing faintly in the bark's patterning, no undergrowth surviving beneath them; deep distance the grove opens onto a cliff-edge where a single stone gargoyle perches silhouetted against the distant fog-filled valley; sky filtered through canopy into dim purple-green twilight.

COASTAL FJORD BLACK CLIFF — sheer obsidian fjord walls plunging to black saltwater; foreground wet cliff-ledge with iron piton stakes and frayed rope, salt crust crystallizing on every surface; midground the fjord stretching inward in perspective, cliff walls so vertical they seem to lean together; deep distance a Gothic ruin of a sea-monastery built into the cliff face halfway up, connected by external iron-railed stairs; sky silver overcast, a waterfall of fog descending from the clifftop, single bat arcing across the gap.

GRAVEYARD CITY — necropolis so vast it functions as a city; foreground cracked flagstone avenues between tomb-rows, iron streetlamps bearing no flame, weeds splitting every joint; midground mausoleum buildings three stories tall lining processional boulevards, carved stone mourners facing inward at every intersection; deep distance the necropolis climbs a hillside and at its peak a cathedral tomb-palace dominates the skyline, its spires intact, its windows dark violet in the moonlight; sky silver-haloed moon, flock of pale moths visible as a silver shimmer.

BROKEN AQUEDUCT PLAIN — ancient stone aqueduct fragmenting across open wasteland; foreground loose cut-stone blocks half-buried in black soil, dead grass threading the joints; midground the aqueduct marches in broken arches for miles, some sections standing full height, others collapsed to stumps; deep distance where the aqueduct terminates at a distant cliff, a fortified gate-structure still stands, green witch-fire burning in its gate-lanterns; sky vast purple-grey twilight, three crows riding thermals between the aqueduct pillars.

HAUNTED LAKE WITH GOTHIC ISLAND — still lake surrounding a fortified island; foreground dark reed-beds at the waterline, rotted wooden dock listing sideways, iron chain descending into black water; midground the lake surface absolute mirror-flat, reflecting the purple sky in perfect inversion; deep distance the island castle-monastery rises from the water's center, its round towers clustered like organ pipes; sky cloud-parted to reveal a single moonlit corridor directly above the island, candle-amber in every tower lancet.

WIND-RAVAGED COASTAL RUIN — clifftop abbey above churning sea; foreground black-grass tufts whipping horizontal, loose limestone cobbles scattered from collapsed walls; midground the abbey's west façade still standing full height, every lancet window a dark void, carved saints eroded to featureless pillars; deep distance the cliff drops sheer to a rocky cove where white foam tears itself apart against black stacks; sky racing storm-cloud backlit by a silver moon, bat silhouettes scattered across the cliff updraft.

CATACOMB-ENTRANCE PLAIN — flat plain pierced by dozens of catacomb entrances; foreground iron grates set flush with the earth every thirty feet, green-black moss framing each one, fel-green light leaking upward; midground the plain stretches to the horizon studded with these portals, between them black standing stones carved with unknown script; deep distance a colosseum-scale stone edifice marks the main catacomb entrance, its facade intact but its archways sealed with iron; sky absolute overcast, a single shaft of moonlight breaking through directly over the main entrance.

MONASTARY RUIN ON CANYON PERCH — cliff-face monastery above a sheer drop; foreground wind-carved stone underfoot, a broken iron railing at the path edge, no ground visible below; midground the monastery clings to the cliff face, its arcade gallery extending on wooden supports over the void, some supports collapsed; deep distance the canyon floor a thousand feet down holds a fog-river glowing faint silver, the far canyon wall bearing carved-relief saints; sky narrow band of violet between cliff tops, pale stars concentrated there.

FROZEN CEMETERY WINTER PASS — snow-blanketed grave-field in a mountain pass; foreground snow-covered headstones emerging like knuckles from white ground, iron fence-posts trailing ice-rime crystals; midground the cemetery slopes upward to a mausoleum colonnade half-buried in snowdrift, columns casting blue shadow; deep distance the pass continues above the cemetery to a dark castle gate just visible through snow-squall; sky low white-grey cloud with breaks showing moonlit silver, wolf-silhouette motionless on the cemetery's highest point.

POISONED FEN AT TWILIGHT — cursed wetland under amber-to-violet sky; foreground black mud cracked in polygons, dead bulrushes bone-pale, iridescent surface-film on standing water; midground the fen stretching flat and enormous, dead trees standing in the water like sentinels, their reflections perfectly doubled in the still surface; deep distance a fortified manor on a slight rise, its windows dark but a single candle burning in the tower; sky the amber-violet sunset bleeding into darkness, will-o-wisps emerging along the tree-line.

MOUNTAIN ROAD TO DARK CITADEL — switchback road ascending a volcanic black mountain; foreground road-cut stone blocks stained with orange mineral seep, rusted iron guide-posts leaning outward; midground each switchback reveals a deeper view of the valley below filling with fog; deep distance the citadel at the summit, half its structure natural rock and half carved masonry, indistinguishable from the mountain itself except for the vertical slits of lit windows; sky coal-black above the peak, the last violet of sunset far below.

ABANDONED VILLAGE AT DUSK — dead settlement in a river-valley hollow; foreground broken cobblestones with black weeds forcing through, an iron well-housing sealed with timber cross-braces; midground the village's two main streets converging on a silent church square, every shutter closed, every door intact but not one candle visible; deep distance the valley wall rises steeply and on its crest a castle watches, two windows burning amber like distant eyes; sky the last copper light draining from the valley floor while the castle-crest catches the final moonrise.

DROWNED TOMB-GARDEN — sunken necropolis where centuries of floodwater have swallowed the crypt-rows to their shoulders; foreground black water holds perfect inverted reflections of leaning obelisks, lily-pads black as coal pressing against carved epitaphs; midground a city of mausoleums stretches miles, iron cemetery gates listing sideways, stone angels half-submerged with only outstretched hands breaking the surface; deep distance a grand mausoleum dome rides above the flood, moonlit violet, vast and unreachable; sky pale silver moon casts a single caustic ripple-track across the water; a lone heron-silhouette stands motionless at the flooded gate.

COASTAL CLIFF CHAPEL RUIN — storm-wracked promontory where a drowned chapel clings to a thousand-foot seacliff; foreground salt-bleached flagstone, sea-campion crushed flat by gale-wind, iron votive rings corroded to lace; midground the chapel's roofless nave faces open ocean, its lancet windows empty and howling, kelp-ropes draped over broken pews of stone; deep distance black water churns in a vast cove far below, ghost-white breakers visible only as pale flickers; sky charcoal cumulus rolls inland trailing veils of silver rain; a single cormorant cuts against the storm.

PETRIFIED BLOOD-BARK GROVE — ancient haunted forest where every trunk has calcified to bone-white stone streaked rust; foreground gnarled root-knuckles break the soil like knucklebones, dry black moss crumbles underfoot, fog clings ankle-high in violet-tinged pools; midground the canopy is skeletal lacework, no leaf surviving, branches interlocked overhead into a cathedral vault that filters moonlight into silver-needle shafts; deep distance the forest floor drops into a lightless gorge where will-o-wisp glow pulses fel-green between the trunks; sky a silver eclipse corona haloes the hidden moon; a crow flock lifts from the canopy like black smoke.

MOUNTAIN-PASS CITADEL APPROACH — an alpine pass at dusk where the road climbs in switchbacks toward a spired fortress perched on an obsidian crag; foreground frost-shattered flagstones heave from the path, iron waymarker posts bent under accumulated snow, black lichen stains every surface; midground the fortress grows with each upward turn, its silhouette a crown of jagged towers against deepening violet sky, the keep wall sheer and unbroken for three hundred feet; deep distance further peaks fold behind the citadel in blue-black recession; sky candle-amber light bleeds from a single tower window far above; a wolf-silhouette pauses on a ridge.

CURSED VILLAGE AT DUSK — aerial view descending over a hamlet of close-packed slate-roofed houses sealed inside a bowl of dead hills; foreground the nearest rooftops show collapsed chimney-stacks, window-glass gone cloudy as cataracts, a village square cobbled in uneven black granite; midground lanes twist between shuttered facades, a dry fountain at their intersection carved with plague-mask grotesques, every door sealed with nail-crossed planks; deep distance the valley rises to a castle silhouette on a far escarpment, lit faintly candle-amber at one high aperture; sky bruised purple twilight overhead; a single bat-swarm spirals up from the belfry.

PETRIFIED DEAD-WOOD GROVE — skeletal forest of calcified oaks, bark white as exposed bone; foreground gnarled root-tangles erupting from frost-cracked soil, pale lichen crusting every joint; midground cathedral-columns of leafless trunks receding into silver murk, will-o-wisps drifting amber between the boles; deep distance a collapsed bell-tower swallowed by the treeline; sky bruised violet, a single crow-spiral marking the canopy's impossible height.

VAST NECROPOLIS PLAIN — tombstone city stretching miles to a moonlit horizon; foreground tilted slate markers half-sunk in black loam, iron funeral-urns tipped and overgrown; midground mausoleum-rows with baroque carved facades, weeping-angel finials cracked at the neck; deep distance a central ossuary-pyramid rising against the dark, candle-amber pinpoints glowing behind slit-windows; sky pewter overcast edged in pale violet, a single bat-ribbon unspooling across the face of the silver moon.

STORM-WRACKED SEA-CLIFF — iron-black coastal cliff dropping sheer to a thrashing ocean; foreground salt-bleached driftwood and fractured limestone at the cliff-edge, dead sea-lavender stalks rattling in the gale; midground the cliff-face streaked white with mineral runoff, gothic lighthouse-tower clinging to an outcrop halfway down; deep distance the horizon swallowed in absolute black sea-storm, green phosphorescence flickering in the wave-troughs far below; sky violent charcoal with pale silver lightning-fractures, no moon visible.

HEATHER-MOOR AT WITCH-FIRE TWILIGHT — windswept heathland under a collapsing dusk; foreground purple heather in dense mats, blackthorn branches low and clawing, a barrow-mound stone-ringed in the near foreground; midground rolling moorland swallowed in ground-fog, pale witch-fire drifting just above the heather-tops in clusters of cold green; deep distance an abbey silhouette, one intact tower, the rest collapsed, backlit by the last violet light; sky gradient from bruised indigo overhead to amber-smear at the horizon.

CORPSE-MARSH DEAD-TREE SPIRE — poisoned fen under silver moonlight; foreground black water thick with grey reed-stalks, the mirror surface broken by half-submerged wooden crosses listing in the mire; midground a plantation of dead cypresses rising like cathedral spires from the swamp, pale bark reflecting moonlight, Spanish-moss hanging in grey curtains; deep distance a ruined gothic manor sinking into the bog, one chimney-stack still erect; sky absolute black overhead, the moon a cold silver disc haloed in thin violet cirrus.

CANYON-GORGE WITH STONE AQUEDUCT — red-ochre canyon walls dropping five hundred feet to a dry riverbed; foreground loose shale at the canyon lip, iron survey-stakes rusted to copper, a single dead juniper twisted over the edge; midground the great aqueduct spanning the gorge, its arched stone piers descending into shadow, one arch cracked but holding; deep distance a cathedral ruin at the canyon's far end, nave open to the sky, rose-window blind and moonlit violet; sky deep indigo, a single wolf-silhouette on the opposite canyon rim.

ALPINE-PASS VAMPIRE-CASTLE — mountain-pass framing a distant dark citadel on a black crag; foreground wind-scoured granite, snow packed into crevices, iron waymarker crusted with ice; midground the pass-road descending through pine-skeleton forest, trees sheared by avalanche, trunks snapped at uniform height; deep distance the castle erupting from the cliff-face, towers asymmetrical and vast, a thousand feet above the pass-floor; sky charcoal-blue with high snow-driven cloud, pale silver moonlight catching the castle's highest turret.

COLLAPSED CATHEDRAL NAVE — roofless Gothic nave under open moonlight; foreground moss-covered flagstones cracked by root-heave, iron choir-screen toppled, lectern carved to a dark-eagle standing in rubble; midground soaring stone piers of the nave arcade still intact, ribs of the destroyed vaulting dangling in mid-air like broken bones; deep distance the apse window intact, moonlit violet glass intact in its tracery, backed by open black sky; sky indigo with slow cloud-drift, a single owl-silhouette crossing the open roof.

FROZEN LAKE WITH GOTHIC CHATEAU — ice-sheet foreground beneath a pewter sky; foreground frost-rimed cattails at the frozen shore, snow-dusted jetty-posts with black iron rings, the ice cracked in concentric arcs; midground the lake surface flat and grey-silver, reflecting a dim aurora-ribbon; deep distance a gothic chateau across the ice, its mansard roofline crusted in snow, three windows glowing amber, baroque turrets half-consumed by bare ivy; sky pale violet-grey, a low aurora ghosting above the roofline, no moon visible.

VOLCANIC ASH-PLAIN — cracked obsidian plain under a grey ash-fall sky; foreground obsidian shards upright like black teeth, pale ash accumulating in the cracks, witch-fire venting from fissures in cold blue-green tongues; midground the plain stretching flat and immense, littered with the arches and column-stumps of a buried city emerging from the ash like bones; deep distance a volcanic cone rising, its crater-rim glowing fell-green in the haze, a ruined basilica silhouetted on its flank; sky grey-white ash-cloud with no sunlight, only a diffuse pewter glow.

HAUNTED VILLAGE AERIAL VIEW — aerial perspective over a cursed valley-village at dusk; foreground rooftops of the near houses, red-clay tiles frost-cracked, chimneys smokeless and cold, a weathervane bat motionless in still air; midground the village grid visible from above, cobbled lanes branching, every shutter closed, a village-square fountain dry and tilted; deep distance a hill-crest castle looming above the village, immense, its black towers dwarfing the houses below; sky bruised purple-blue, a flock of starlings murmurating above the castle in a single dark shape.

FORTIFIED BRIDGE CROSSING — vast stone bridge over a gorge-river in twilight; foreground the bridge-approach road, cobblestones heaved by frost, iron torch-sconces unlit and corroded; midground the bridge itself, broad and battlemented, with watchtower-piers at its midpoint, the gorge-walls dropping into black mist far below; deep distance the far bank, a fortified gate-house with portcullis raised, beyond it the first towers of a dark citadel emerging from purple haze; sky rolling violet thunderheads, pale silver light breaking through in one god-ray onto the bridge-deck.

DROWNED CHAPEL IN BLACK WATER — submerged gothic chapel in an inland bog; foreground black-water surface perfectly still, the chapel's bell-tower rising just above it, iron cross intact, encrusted with green; midground the water spreading acres in every direction, dead willow-stumps breaking the surface, a will-o-wisp cluster drifting fel-green near the tower; deep distance fog-wall at the bog's edge, treeline barely discernible, a single lamp-glow in the mist of uncertain origin; sky moonless black with low violet cloud reflecting the green witch-fire below.

BARROWS-FIELD MOORLAND — ancient burial-mound field on a black-heather moor; foreground a barrow's earthen flank rising steep, dry grass stiff with frost, capstone slabs jutting from the mound-crest; midground the moor covered in a dozen barrows of varying scale, each stone-ringed, linked by a ghost-road of pale gravel; deep distance a tall standing-stone monolith alone on the horizon-line, a ruin of a priory just behind it catching the last amber edge of sunset; sky full violet dusk with a bone-white crescent moon just clearing the horizon.

MONASTERY ROOFTOP ABOVE FOREST — cliff-edge monastery, roofline emerging from haunted forest canopy; foreground massive stone gargoyles at the parapet-corners, lichen-eaten, looking down into forest dark below; midground the forest canopy spreading in every direction, black treetops in rolling waves, the monastery's inner courtyard visible below with cracked flagstones and a dry fountain; deep distance a mountain-range beyond the forest, its peaks hidden in low cloud, one pass lit faintly by a distant torch-cluster; sky pewter dawn, not yet light, one star remaining above the bell-tower.

FJORD WITH SHEER BLACK CLIFFS — gothic fjord, cliffs dropping hundreds of feet to still black water; foreground the cliff-edge, dark basalt cracked in hexagonal columns, sea-pink dead and dry in the crevices; midground the fjord-water a perfect black mirror, the cliff-faces reflected perfectly, doubling their height; deep distance the fjord-head, where the water narrows and a gothic watchtower stands on a rock-pillar rising from the water, amber light in its single window; sky violet dusk with horizontal pink-gold at the cloud-base, a single cormorant silhouette on an iron-black sea-stack.

ABBEY COURTYARD RUIN — collapsed abbey in an overgrown hillside courtyard; foreground broken cloister-paving with weeds in every crack, a toppled stone baptismal font, iron bench-frames green with patina; midground the remaining abbey walls, roofless, full gothic window-frames intact and showing sky through empty tracery filled with climbing ivy; deep distance beyond the open east wall, a valley dropping away into fog, distant bell-tower of another ruin visible barely above the mist-level; sky slow-moving violet cloud with pale moonlight reading as diffuse silver, no moon-disc visible.

CURSED CITY OF RED-TILE ROOFS — gothic city-scape under a pre-storm sky; foreground a stone parapet or city-wall battlement edge, lichen-crusted iron cannon-ring, a single gargoyle drain-spout; midground the city's densely packed red-tile and black-slate roofscape descending toward a central plaza, cathedral-spire at its heart; deep distance the city wall on the far side, and beyond it moorland dissolving into dark, a single distant citadel on a hill; sky charcoal-green storm-front advancing, white lightning threading its base, the city in the last still moment before the storm breaks.

SMOLDERING CRATER-FIELD — volcanic crater-field, witch-fire venting from every fissure; foreground cracked orange-black basalt, heat-shimmer above each vent, ash-residue pale grey in the crevice-lines; midground the crater-field pocked with dozens of vents and two large open craters, their interiors lit fel-green and cold-blue by witch-fire rather than lava; deep distance a ruined obsidian-spire city on a plateau above the field, towers intact but lifeless; sky permanent overcast of grey-white ash-cloud, a diffuse green glow from below illuminating the underside of the cloud.

SEA-CAVE GOTHIC RUIN — sea-cave mouth at the base of coastal cliffs, gothic ruin growing from the cliff-face; foreground wet black rock, tide-pools reflecting silver sky, barnacle-encrusted iron rings set into stone; midground the cave-mouth enormous, the ruin's arched facade built into it, gothic windows looking out to sea, dark within; deep distance from inside the cave looking out: open grey ocean to the horizon, two sea-stacks like broken towers in the middle-distance; sky the sliver of visible sky above the cave-mouth a narrow band of violet, a single gannet-silhouette in the gap.

SNOW-PILED CEMETERY IN ICE-RIMED WINTER — cemetery under heavy snowfall, every marker buried to its shoulder; foreground deep snow-crust over a flat grave-field, iron-cross grave-markers emerging from the white, their metal rimed with clear ice, snow-loaded holly-branches bowed low; midground the cemetery's central avenue of yew-trees black against white, snow-laden boughs forming a dark tunnel, a stone mausoleum with ice-glazed doors at the avenue's end; deep distance a fortress-chapel on a snow-covered rise beyond the cemetery, single amber candlelight in one lancet-window; sky dense grey snow-cloud, a pale silver diffusion where the moon hides, a crow motionless on the nearest iron cross.

DEADWOOD CATHEDRAL FOREST — petrified black-bark spires forming a skeletal nave miles wide; foreground gnarled root-slabs crusted with phosphorescent lichen and shredded bark-peel curling like burnt manuscript pages; midground columns of ashen trunks soaring sixty feet, canopy locked into a lattice that filters moonlight into silver-thread curtains; deep distance a pale fog-wall swallowing the forest floor whole; sky ink-violet with a single pale moon; a distant crow-flock disperses like black ash against the canopy.

NECROPOLIS OF THE SUNKEN CRYPTS — a vast cemetery stretching miles across a sloped hillside of cracked black limestone; foreground headstones tilted at grief-angles, their carvings blurred by centuries of iron-grey lichen; midground rows of above-ground sepulchres with iron-grate doors hanging open, wilted black-rose garlands rotting across stone thresholds; deep distance a mausoleum citadel rising on the hilltop, its spires swallowed by low violet cloud; sky a bruised indigo pre-dawn; a single bat silhouette arcs between the nearest obelisks.

CASTLE APPROACH — VALLEY FLOOR TO CRAG-SPIRE — a mountain valley floor of black shale and dead sedge stretching a mile before a sheer basalt cliff; foreground ankle-deep mist pooling between stone rubble and rusted chain-links of a collapsed gate; midground the cliff-face broken by a switchback road carved directly into rock, flanked by iron torch-brackets holding no flame; deep distance the castle erupts from the cliff-crown, its spired silhouette fracturing the low storm-clouds; sky rolling charcoal cumulus; a wolf-silhouette stands motionless at the switchback base.

DROWNED ABBEY COURTYARD — a once-grand abbey complex now half-consumed by black-water marsh; foreground slate-grey water lapping against collapsed colonnades, the surface sheened with witch-fire green reflections; midground the abbey's nave walls rise from the flood, windows dark and frame-empty, vines of poisoned black ivy stitching across the stone face; deep distance the intact bell-tower stands impossibly tall above the waterline, its crown fog-ringed; sky pewter-grey overcast; a pair of bat silhouettes circle the bell-tower peak.

STORM-WRACKED COASTAL CLIFF — an Atlantic-scale cliff of black basalt dropping a thousand feet into seething pale foam; foreground cliff-edge grass tearing in gale-force wind, exposing the raw dark rock beneath, scattered with bleached driftwood bones; midground a ruined lighthouse-tower with candlelight amber flickering in the single surviving window, its lamp-room shattered; deep distance the ocean churns to the horizon, a spine of jagged sea-stacks vanishing into squall-haze; sky boiling pewter-grey, lightning-threaded; a single gull drifts like a torn page.

HEATHER-MOOR WITH BARROW-FIELD — a wind-stripped moorland plateau under a bruised violet twilight; foreground black heather-roots and frost-cracked peat, standing stones listing in the thin soil, their surfaces etched with worn spiral-glyphs; midground a field of ancient grass-mounded barrows stretching across the plateau, their arrangement following no rational grid; deep distance an abbey ruin silhouette cuts the horizon, a single amber candle-glow in the tower-slit; sky pale violet fading to ink at the zenith; a crow stands atop the nearest barrow.

FROZEN LAKE ESTATE — a vast frozen-lake foreground of black ice reflecting a silver-violet moonlit sky; foreground fractured ice-plates crunching upward like broken teeth, dead reeds locked in the freeze; midground the far shore a dark smear of bare birch-trees backing a gothic chateau whose candle-amber windows glow in pale yellow warmth; deep distance snow-laden mountain-spurs close the valley, a second tower barely visible through ice-fog; sky a pale silver moon behind thin cloud-lace; fog-curls drift low above the ice-surface.

VOLCANIC ASH PLAIN — a smoldering obsidian plateau of cracked black stone webbed with glowing orange fissures; foreground ankle-deep grey ash drifting like snow, burying the lower half of a broken monolith whose inscription is still partially legible; midground a ruined city of collapsed colonnades and toppled bell-towers emerging from the ash-sea, witch-fire vents hissing pale green jets between the rubble-rows; deep distance a volcanic caldera wall rising as a black crescent; sky ochre-ash haze through which a pale eclipsed moon glows silver-ringed.

CLIFF-TOP FORTRESS — COASTAL HEADLAND — a headland of sheer pale chalk dropping five hundred feet on three sides into a black sea; foreground cliff-edge cracked and eroded, iron anchor-posts sunk into the rock with corroded chain swinging in the wind; midground the fortress walls rising directly from the cliff-crown, their crenellations broken into serrated silhouettes, towers uneven in height like rotted teeth; deep distance the open sea all the way to the iron horizon; sky storm-violet with lightning-flash behind the towers; a bat-colony erupts from the wall-face.

CURSED VILLAGE — AERIAL DUSK VIEW — an aerial perspective over a tightly packed village of steep red-tile rooftops and crooked chimney-stacks, all dark and smokeless; foreground the nearest rooftop covered in black moss and collapsed at one corner, a weathervane frozen mid-spin; midground winding lanes forming an irregular web through the village, iron lamp-posts cold and unlit; deep distance the village dissolves into autumn-stripped orchards, and beyond, a castle on a hill with a single candlelit tower window burning amber; sky deep violet dusk; a crow-flock wheels over the highest steeple.

MOUNTAIN PASS — VAMPIRE-CASTLE APPROACH — a high alpine pass of grey scree and black ice beneath permanent overcast; foreground wind-polished boulders capped with frost, the pass road a pale stripe of gravel disappearing into shadow; midground cliff-walls close in on both sides, iron chains bolted into the rock face as if something heavy was once suspended there; deep distance the castle sits on an isolated crag above the pass-exit, its silhouette impossibly complex with towers of unequal spires; sky iron-grey cloud; snow falls sideways; a wolf-silhouette moves along the ridge-line.

SUBMERGED CRYPT MARSHLAND — a corpse-marsh at blue-hour, its black water so still it mirrors the sky; foreground dead-tree trunks rising from the waterline like grey femurs, their root-stumps wrapped in oil-dark weed; midground half-submerged crypts with only their pediment-peaks above water, iron crosses listing, will-o-wisps gliding an inch above the surface between them; deep distance a cathedral ruin on a low island, its nave open to the sky, a fel-green light pulsing from the tower-base; sky midnight blue with pearl moon; single bat traces the canal between crypts.

ABBEY RUIN — BROKEN STATUARY COURT — a vast abbey courtyard exposed to the sky after the roof collapsed centuries ago; foreground broken flagstones with black grass forcing through every joint, a toppled angel-statue face-down, its wings shattered into separate slabs; midground the remaining walls of the nave pierced by tall lancet-windows whose glass is long gone, moonlit violet sky visible through every opening; deep distance the abbey tower stands intact and alone beyond the nave-ruin, a single amber candle-glow in the lancet-slit; sky moonlit violet; a single crow perches on the tower-crown.

FJORD WITH BLACK-CLIFF WALLS — a narrow fjord of black mirror-water pressed between vertical cliff-walls of dark basalt soaring eight hundred feet; foreground the fjord-shore of wet black gravel, driftwood bleached bone-white, a collapsed stone dock half-submerged; midground the fjord walls draped in wet black moss and fed by thin silver waterfalls; deep distance the fjord narrows to a vanishing point where a gothic tower-ruin stands on a natural sea-stack; sky a sliver of violet sky between cliff-tops, one pale star; sea-mist rolls inward from the fjord-mouth.

WIND-SWEPT BLACKTHORN WASTE — a lowland plain of tangled blackthorn, every branch stripped of leaves and interlocked into a black wire-thicket; foreground thorns close enough to read, their tips white-sharp, bleached animal skulls caught in the lower branches; midground the thicket stretches to every horizon at eye-level, broken only by a buried stone wall revealing itself as a line of moss-capped humps; deep distance a solitary tower-ruin rises above the thicket-line, its crown lost in low grey cloud; sky flat iron-grey with pewter light; a crow hops along the buried wall.

DROWNED VILLAGE FORESHORE — a coastal foreshore where the sea has partially reclaimed a village, rooftops emerging from the tideline at low water; foreground wet sand mixed with broken roof-tile shards and fragments of iron window-grates, seaweed wrapping them like dark bandages; midground three-story stone house-walls standing to half-height, their interiors flooded, dark windows framing black water; deep distance a gothic church tower rises from the sea a hundred meters offshore, its spire intact, a candle-amber light in the belfry slit; sky pale pewter with sea-fog; a gull perches on the submerged steeple cross.

IRON-CEMETERY — WINTER SNOWFALL — a vast cemetery under heavy snowfall that silences everything; foreground snow-blanketed ground with only the top halves of headstones visible, iron grave-rails just breaking the surface like black fingers; midground rows of obelisk tombs with snow-caps balanced on every horizontal surface, iron gate-doors caked with ice, the whole field stretching to the horizon; deep distance a cemetery chapel with a rose-window dark and frost-patterned, its tower wreathed in blowing snow; sky white-grey void of constant snowfall; a crow lands on the nearest obelisk, scattering its snow-cap.

OBSIDIAN CASTLE — ALPINE WINTER CRAG — a single enormous castle of black stone erupting from a sheer alpine crag above a snow-buried valley; foreground deep snow covering the lower approach road to the waist, broken by the tips of iron fence-posts in a line; midground the crag's vertical face of slick black rock, the castle wall growing directly from it, indistinguishable from the geology; deep distance the valley floor a thousand feet below, a single amber light in a farmhouse barely visible through snow-haze; sky iron-grey blizzard-cloud; lightning illuminates the topmost tower.

MOSS-CATHEDRAL FOREST — a forest of ancient yew-trees whose canopy has grown so dense it forms a vaulted ceiling of woven branches; foreground deep green-black moss covering every surface, the ground utterly soundless, fallen branches consumed into the moss-floor like absorbed bodies; midground columns of yew-trunks so old they have developed ridge-and-furrow bark-architecture resembling fluted columns, their canopy-vaults filtering moonlight to pale green pools; deep distance the forest thins onto a wide dark clearing where a single standing stone rises; sky moonlit violet; a distant crow-flock passes above the canopy.

RUINED FORTIFIED BRIDGE — a great fortified bridge of pale limestone spanning a fog-filled gorge; foreground bridge-deck cracked through the centre, black grass filling the fissures, gargoyle water-spouts leaning outward with broken noses; midground the bridge towers at mid-span, their battlements collapsed into rubble-piles on the roadway, iron portcullis-gates buckled and frozen half-down; deep distance the far bank towers into a crag on which a citadel stands, its highest spire piercing the cloud-base; sky purple-grey with pale moonlit aura; fog fills the gorge below the bridge-arch-line completely.

ASH-FALL RUINED CITY — a once-great city now buried chest-deep in grey volcanic ash, only the upper halves of buildings protruding; foreground dry ash surface cracked into hexagonal plates, the tops of iron lamp-posts emerging at knee height; midground cathedral spires and palazzo-towers rising from the ash-sea in diminishing ranks, some leaning at catastrophic angles, others intact with dark lancet-windows still holding lead-glass turned grey with soot; deep distance the volcanic caldera itself, glowing at the throat with dull orange, ringed by ash-cloud; sky amber-grey haze, eclipsed pale moon; witch-fire vents pulse green between the buried towers.

HAUNTED FOREST — BLACKENED CANOPY CATHEDRAL; foreground gnarled root-slabs pushing through frost-cracked soil, tattered lichen hanging in silver threads; midground skeletal oaks arranged like nave pillars, their crowns interlocking into a vaulted ceiling of dead branches, will-o-wisps drifting between trunks in pale green pulses; deep distance a collapsed bell-tower swallowed by the wood, its single remaining arch haloed in fog; sky a sliver of violet moonlight cutting the canopy.

VAST CEMETERY — NECROPOLIS OF A THOUSAND OBELISKS; foreground cracked marble slabs erupting from black soil, iron funerary chains draped between posts, moss-velvet cushioning every carved epitaph; midground an endless field of obelisks and baroque mausoleums receding in staggered rows, candle-amber light bleeding from one sealed crypt-door; deep distance a cathedral-spire rising above the grave-city, its silhouette sharp against silver cloud-mass; sky a pale full moon washing everything in cold pewter.

DROWNED SWAMP RUIN — CORPSE-MARSH CATHEDRAL; foreground black water surface broken by half-submerged grave-markers, surface tension iridescent with rot-shimmer, dead cypress knees erupting from the shallows; midground a collapsed cathedral absorbed into the marsh, its rose-window cavity now a black mirror reflecting witch-fire globes drifting at water level; deep distance strangled bell-towers leaning against each other across the bog, mist threading between them in slow coils; sky a bruised green-violet canopy of storm-cloud, no stars visible.

COASTAL SEA-CLIFF — LIGHTHOUSE OF THE DROWNED; foreground tide-smoothed obsidian rocks at the cliff base, barnacle-crusted chains from a long-severed drawbridge dangling into crashing surf; midground vertical black cliffs climbing three hundred feet, an abandoned lighthouse-tower clinging to the face, its lantern-room dark but faintly fogged with amber condensation; deep distance a second headland across the churning bay carrying a half-collapsed gothic manor, single violet window faintly lit; sky churning ash-grey oceanic clouds with a low silver moon caught between wave and cloud.

CEMETERY — SUNKEN TOMB GARDEN; foreground ornate iron fence half-dissolved by verdigris, tomb-garden paths paved with illegible grave-tiles sinking into black earth; midground rows of above-ground sarcophagi arranged in baroque herringbone patterns, each crowned with a weeping-angel carving worn featureless by rain; deep distance a family mausoleum the size of a cathedral rising on a raised platform, its copper-dome gone fully black-green; sky a ceiling of slow-rolling fog pierced by the mausoleum's finial, a single crow circling.

MOORLAND — BARROWS-FIELD AT DUSK; foreground heather-purple and black-gorse lowland, wind-combed into visible wave-patterns, the ground surface beaded with recent rain; midground a mile-wide field of prehistoric burial mounds arranged in irregular clusters, each mound rimmed by leaning standing stones, fog pooling in the low ground between them; deep distance a ruined abbey silhouette low on the horizon, its broken tower the only vertical in a flat world; sky a band of deep amber twilight at the horizon crushed beneath a purple storm-ceiling, a wolf-silhouette moving.

VOLCANIC WASTELAND — OBSIDIAN PLAIN WITH ASH-FALL; foreground cracked obsidian ground, edges of each crack glowing faint ember-orange from below, ash accumulating in irregular drifts against every hard edge; midground a vast ruined city of black stone half-buried in ash-dunes, spires and columns emerging at steep angles from the accumulation, witch-fire vents flaring jade-green at irregular intervals; deep distance a volcanic caldera rim, glowing at its lip like a crown, distant lava-rivers tracing orange veins in the dark; sky a canopy of grey ash-cloud lit from below by the volcanic glow, giving the overcast a sickly amber bruise.

FROZEN LAKE — GOTHIC CHATEAU ACROSS THE ICE; foreground the frozen lake surface, black ice so clear the drowned reeds below are visible pressed against it, snow drifted in baroque spirals by the last wind; midground the lake expanse stretching a quarter-mile, its surface cracked into vast pressure-plates outlined in frost-white, a single candle-amber window reflecting in the ice from the far shore; deep distance the chateau rises directly from the frozen lake-edge, its mansard rooflines heavy with snow, towers thin and very tall, the whole structure violet-shadowed; sky a silver full moon directly overhead, its reflection a perfect oval trapped in black ice.

MOOR — CURSED FEN WITH ROLLING FOG; foreground soft bog-mat underfoot, the surface quaking, pools of brown-black water between tussocks of dead marsh-grass, iron-colored standing water; midground fog rolls in from the low ground in continuous slow waves, consuming distance, a ring of twisted willows marking where solid ground ends and open fen begins, will-o-wisps pulsing above the deep water; deep distance a stone bridge of three arches emerging from the fog mid-structure with no visible land on either side; sky pale grey overcast with a diffuse silver luminescence where the moon must be.

CATHEDRAL RUIN — BROKEN STATUARY COURTYARD; foreground abbey-courtyard cobbles, each stone heaved upward by tree-root pressure, fallen carved heads of saints lying at random angles in the grass; midground the cathedral's south transept wall standing alone, its window openings vacant and moon-backed, massive buttresses cleaved from the main body and leaning against each other for support; deep distance the intact chapter-house dome survives at the ruin's far end, its leaded roof faintly glinting silver under the moon, candle-green light visible within one high vent; sky racing silver-edged clouds shredded by the surviving spire-stump.

CANYON GORGE — STONE AQUEDUCT BRIDGING THE CHASM; foreground the gorge-lip, fractured limestone edged with iron-grey lichen, a crumbling carved-stone parapet suggesting a long-collapsed road; midground the canyon drops away seven hundred feet, walls of layered orange-black stone banded in horizontal strata, a massive Romanesque stone aqueduct bridging the full chasm at mid-height, its arches spanning the void; deep distance across the canyon a cliff-face monastery is cut directly into the rock at varying levels, dark window-slots in rows, a single lit amber cell; sky a narrow slot of bruised violet sky above the canyon, a hawk-sized silhouette riding the thermal.

SWAMP — POISONED FEN AT TWILIGHT; foreground teal-tinged still water reflecting a lime-green sky edge, surface broken by floating pads of black algae, dead tree-trunks emerging at sharp angles; midground an unnatural grove of black-water cypress half-drowned, each trunk furred with pale moss, the water between them perfectly still and opaque, its surface giving back faint witch-fire reflections with no visible source above; deep distance a collapsed gothic estate only partially visible above the swamp-level, one intact dormer-window above the tree-line with warm amber interior-glow; sky a lurid yellow-green horizon-band at dusk being consumed by advancing violet cloud.

COASTAL FJORD — BLACK-CLIFF SEA-WALLS; foreground tide-scoured volcanic rock at sea-level, iron-dark and sharp, kelp trailing in slow surge-pull, a Gothic-arch sea-cave entrance cut into the base of the cliff; midground sheer fjord walls rising six hundred feet on both sides, black dolerite columns formed into natural pilasters, surface streaked silver by thin waterfalls; deep distance the fjord closes into a headwall where a massive chain-fortress straddles the water, two towers connected by a chain-gate above the channel, a dim violet lamp on the portcullis arch; sky a silver-blue overcast with the moon a diffused bright disc, light carving the cliff edges into white lines.

ALPINE MOUNTAIN PASS — VAMPIRE CRAG FORTRESS; foreground packed-ice road with buried iron carriage-ruts just visible through the glaze, roadside fir-trees black with frost, their branches snapped under ice-load; midground the mountain-pass walls close in to a gate of natural rock, the fortress walls growing organically from the crag so the division between cliff and masonry is invisible, towers growing from bare rock-shelves with no visible base; deep distance above the fortress the mountain summit rises another two thousand feet, permanent cloud-veil obscuring the top, faint violet corona tracing the cloud-edge; sky violent cold-white stars in the bands of clear sky between cloud-masses, a bat-cluster wheeling before the moon.

CLIFF-TOP FORTRESS SILHOUETTE — a castle-approach along a mountain ridge with a thousand-foot drop to either side; foreground: wind-scoured flagstones cracked by frost-heave, iron chain-posts rattling in the gale, patches of black ice sheening silver; midground: the ridge road narrows between sheer rock faces, ruined watchtower stumps lining the path like broken teeth; deep distance: the main citadel erupts against the skyline, spires piercing low cloud, its silhouette all jagged asymmetric pinnacles; sky: blue-black storm-ceiling, lightning threading the clouds.

STORM-WRACKED SEA CLIFF — a coastal-cliff biome above a North-Atlantic fury; foreground: black basalt rock fractured into hexagonal columns, salt-crusted and dripping, sea-pinks dead and skeletal in iron-hard soil; midground: the clifftop path runs along a five-hundred-foot edge, an abandoned lighthouse-tower leaning outward over the drop, its lamp chamber dark; deep distance: the ocean stretches to infinite horizon, white-capped and steel-grey, a drowning village's rooftops visible far below at the cliff's base; sky: torn clouds racing, pale gold seam at the horizon.

ABBEY COURTYARD WITH BROKEN STATUARY — a cathedral-ruin biome of monastic decay; foreground: flagstone courtyard split by tree-root intrusion, each crack filled with black water, fragments of carved angels face-down in the moss; midground: roofless abbey walls rise thirty feet on three sides, their tracery windows stripped to bare stone lattice that frames sections of moving sky; deep distance: the abbey's main tower still stands at its full height a quarter-mile, its belfry silhouette intact against luminous cloud; sky: fast-moving silver-and-pewter cloud, moonlight pulsing in waves across the ruins.

CORPSE MARSH WITH DEAD-TREE SPIRES — a wetland biome of gothic vertical drama; foreground: black peat-water ankle-deep, bubbling slowly with marsh-gas, dead white sedge bent flat by wind; midground: the marsh extends for miles, out of which dead cypresses and drowned oaks erupt sixty feet into the air, bark stripped silver-white, their upper branches hung with old rope and iron bell-fragments that clang dully; deep distance: a collapsed cathedral tower rises from the deepest water, its spire snapped to a jagged stump; sky: low green-tinged mist-ceiling, will-o-wisps clustered around the bell-branches.

VAMPIRE CASTLE ALPINE CRAG — a mountain-pass biome with fortress above; foreground: snow-covered switchback path edged by iron-black spruce, drifts knee-deep, each footfall silent in packed powder; midground: the pass tightens between two granite faces streaked with old avalanche paths, a stone gatehouse ruin spanning the gap, its portcullis frozen mid-descent; deep distance: the castle explodes from the mountain's summit crag, its towers impossibly tall against snow-crowned peaks, one thin smoke-thread rising from the keep; sky: pale silver-blue, windblown snow catching moonlight like moving silk.

PETRIFIED FOREST BOG — dead woodland meets black-water swamp; foreground: gnarled root-buttresses emerge from stagnant black pools, coated in phosphorescent green slime, frog-spawn masses glowing faintly; midground: rows of calcified trunks stand in varying stages of collapse, their reflections perfect in the still water, doubling the forest depth; deep distance: beyond the tree-line the bog opens into a vast flat mirror that reflects a ruined fortified keep on the far bank, violet sky doubled below; sky: overcast with diffuse moonlight, mist-layers sliding between the dead trunks at different heights.

VOLCANIC ASH-FALL PLAIN — an ash-wasteland biome of smoldering desolation; foreground: cracked obsidian slabs still warm underfoot, ash three inches deep on every flat surface, curling upward in slow grey ribbons; midground: the plain is scattered with collapsed colonnades and statue-plinths, every surface grey-white under accumulated ash-fall, witch-fire vents in the rock pulsing pale green at irregular intervals; deep distance: a vast smoldering volcanic cone dominates the horizon, its flanks veined with cooling lava-channels that glow dull copper; sky: ash-cloud ceiling at low altitude, filtered light giving everything a bone-white pallor.

CATACOMB ENTRANCE PLAIN — a necropolis biome of underground threshold; foreground: iron catacomb-entrance grates protrude from the hillside at intervals, black iron filigree worked with skull-and-bone motifs, ground-mist escaping through each grate; midground: a landscape of above-ground crypt-rows in dressed stone lines the slope, each crypt sealed with a different iron door, the aggregate forming a city-skyline in miniature; deep distance: the valley below shows a walled necropolis a mile square, its interior dense with obelisks and monument-towers; sky: deep purple dusk, gold afterglow on the horizon, bat-cloud emerging from the nearest grate.

MOORLAND CURSED FEN — a heathland biome of rolling fog-banks; foreground: peat-hummocks studded with white skull-moss, black puddles reflecting nothing, iron-age timber trackway planks half-swallowed by bog; midground: fog rolls in sheets across the fen, thinning and thickening, revealing and swallowing a field of leaning prehistoric stone columns carved with spiral motifs; deep distance: a solitary black-thorned hill rises from the fog-sea, a collapsed watchtower on its crest, a single candle-amber window in its remaining wall; sky: vast silver-grey overcast, moon a diffuse glow, wolf-silhouette motionless on the carved stones.

ABOVE-GROUND CRYPT-ROW CITY — a cemetery biome of baroque monumental scale; foreground: marble crypt-facades carved with weeping figures and iron door-knockers shaped as hands, the marble stained amber and black with centuries of weather; midground: crypt-streets radiate outward in Baroque grid-plan, each street a canyon of ten-foot mausoleum walls, street-lamps iron and dark, ground-fog at knee height; deep distance: a central ossuary-cathedral rises above the crypt-city, its nave collapsed but its twin towers intact, pale green light in its rose-window socket; sky: cold blue-black zenith, silver moon directly overhead casting hard mausoleum shadows.

BLACKTHORN WASTE MOOR — a heath biome of horizontal severity; foreground: blackthorn scrub in dense impenetrable mats, thorns three inches long, dead white flowers still clinging like scraps of lace; midground: the waste extends in every direction, perfectly flat, broken only by a stone field-wall that runs to the horizon and the ruins of a solitary chapel with its roof gone and its bell-tower snapped at mid-height; deep distance: six miles out, an escarpment edge carries a line of ruined abbey buildings silhouetted in sharp profile against dying orange sky; sky: horizontal bands of amber, violet, and black, a single crow riding thermals.

VALLEY FLOOR LOOKING UP AT SPIRED CITADEL — a castle-approach biome from below; foreground: valley floor covered in dead grey grass, scattered with the broken spokes of ancient wooden carts and the remnants of an abandoned market, iron-black puddles reflecting sky; midground: the approach road climbs steeply, lined by decapitated stone statues on pedestals, each body intact but headless, leading the eye upward; deep distance: the citadel sits on a sheer-faced mesa above, its spires impossibly numerous against churning storm-cloud, a single lit window amber in the highest keep; sky: green-tinged thunderheads, lightning behind the citadel in long branching forks.

WIND-SWEPT COASTAL BARROW HEADLAND — a moorland-coastal biome of exposed antiquity; foreground: short turf cropped to the bone by sea-wind, scattered white quartz chunks marking old burials, salt-taste in the heavy air; midground: a field of stone-slab barrows occupies the headland plateau, each original covering-stone still in place but tilted by root-heave, iron-grey moss across every surface; deep distance: the headland drops to sheer sea-cliff, the ocean below silver-white with whitecaps, a ruined signal-tower on the furthest point leaning outward over the drop; sky: racing silver cloud-rafts at low altitude, a pale moon half-visible, gull-flock wheeling white against dark water.

SMOLDERING CRATER FIELD WITH WITCH-FIRE VENTS — a volcanic biome of infernal quiet; foreground: grey pumice gravel crunches underfoot, each step sinking slightly, heat rising through the soles, concentric ring-cracks around each vent-mouth glowing orange at depth; midground: the crater field is vast and bowl-shaped, scattered with the collapsed walls of an ancient city whose basalt blocks have been shifted and cracked by subsidence, pale green witch-fire venting steadily from each fracture; deep distance: the crater rim circles the entire scene, and beyond its highest point a single intact bell-tower protrudes, silhouetted against a copper-bruised sky; sky: permanent ash-haze, stars visible as dim points, the witch-fire glow casting green shadows upward onto the ash-cloud underside.

VAST CEMETERY PLAIN — tombstone fields rolling for miles across low hillocks; foreground cracked marble slabs tilted at grief-angles, dead roses calcified against the stone faces; midground mausoleum rows rising like a stone city, iron-gate archways trailing black vine; deep distance an obelisk-crowned necropolis hill swallowed in ground-mist; sky cold pewter twilight bleeding into indigo at the zenith, a single bat silhouette banking above the farthest crypt-tower.

CLIFF-TOP CITADEL APPROACH — mountain-pass road rising toward a fortress perched impossibly on a sheer basalt promontory; foreground frost-split cobblestone paving, dead thistle in the road-cracks, iron milestone worn featureless; midground the pass walls close to cathedral-narrow, obsidian cliff-faces sheering a thousand feet each side; deep distance the citadel erupts spires into the cloud-base, every window a dark violet void; sky churning storm-shelf, a pale corona moon barely visible behind the tower-crown.

HEATHER MOOR AT TWILIGHT — windswept lowland heath running to the horizon under dying amber-to-indigo sky; foreground heather and blackthorn scrub, frost-silver cobwebs bridging each stem, a split barrow-stone half-buried; midground rolling fog-tongue creeping from a distant fen, barrow-mounds humped along a ridgeline; deep distance the silhouette of a ruined abbey stands the far edge, its west-tower still intact against pale twilight; sky deepening purple, a wolf-silhouette cresting the nearest barrow-ridge.

CORPSE-MARSH WITH DEAD-TREE SPIRES — poisoned wetland stretching to the horizon, black water mirror-still; foreground tussock-moss and submerged root-systems, amber methane-bubbles drifting the surface; midground dead tree-spires ascending from the water like a drowned cathedral forest, will-o-wisps cycling between them in green-gold spirals; deep distance a half-submerged manor-house lists at forty-five degrees, its chimney-stacks above water, candlelit amber in a single intact upper window; sky iron-grey overcast, moonlight diffuse and silver beneath it.

MAUSOLEUM CITY — above-ground crypt-rows extending for miles in receding perspective; foreground polished dark granite tomb-facades, bronze door-panels green with verdigris, dead wisteria lacing the pediments; midground the crypt-rows multiply into a city-scale necropolis, obelisks and carved angels rising at intersections; deep distance a central pyramid-mausoleum dominates, three hundred feet tall, fog pooling at its base; sky cobalt pre-dawn, a massive crow-flock spiraling the pyramid in total silence.

ALPINE VAMPIRE-CRAG PASS — snow-crowned mountain pass ascending to a dark castle fused to the cliff-face itself; foreground ice-rimed road-stone, dead alpine flowers pressed flat under hoarfrost, boot-worn steps carved into living rock; midground the pass narrows between thousand-foot walls, icicle formations hanging cathedral-vault-like overhead; deep distance the castle erupts from the summit crag, its towers indistinguishable from the rock pinnacles; sky bone-white overcast, a single silver moon-sliver visible above the highest spire.

CATHEDRAL RUIN IN RED-ROCK CANYON — collapsed Gothic cathedral nave built into a canyon alcove; foreground canyon-floor sand drifted against fallen column-drums, bone-dry desert sage and black-thorned cactus; midground the nave walls stand sixty feet, flying-buttress stubs clawing the canyon wall, stained-glass frames empty and wind-howling; deep distance the canyon bends revealing more ruin, a rose window frame backlist by pale moonlight, bats streaming from the triforium gaps; sky deep canyon-violet, stars visible in the slit of sky above.

VOLCANIC OBSIDIAN PLAIN — cracked obsidian flatland extending miles under a sky of permanent ash-fall; foreground shattered volcanic glass in plates, witch-fire vents exhaling sulphur-green flame-tongues two feet high; midground the plain is studded with the ruins of an ancient city, columns snapped at mid-height, arch-ribs of a vast basilica standing skeletal; deep distance a volcanic cone smolders on the horizon, a slow lava-tongue tracing orange-to-black down its flank; sky rolling grey ash-cloud, moon a pale green-silver disc behind the haze.

FORTIFIED-BRIDGE CROSSING — a gorge-spanning Gothic fortified bridge, its towers rising over a chasm of absolute darkness; foreground bridge-stone surface cracked and mossy, iron torch-brackets empty and rust-streaked, gargoyle drain-heads leering from parapets; midground the bridge spans an abyss of eight hundred feet, the twin gate-towers mid-span rising like castle-keeps; deep distance the far bank vanishes into mountain-fog, a faint light in a tower window the only warmth; sky violent grey-violet storm-shelf, lightning illuminating the gorge-walls below.

GOTHIC CLIFF-FACE MONASTERY — cliff-perch monastery built directly into a sheer limestone escarpment; foreground loose talus slope at the cliff-base, carved steps disappearing into rockfall, iron lantern-posts corroded to lace; midground the cliff-face rises three hundred feet, the monastery buildings cantilevered and embedded, flying-buttresses anchoring to the rock; deep distance the escarpment continues for miles, monastery towers visible at intervals along the cliff like vertebrae; sky pewter overcast with one violet-lit break, a crow flock riding the cliff thermals.

BLACKTHORN WASTE — BARROWS FIELD — windswept barrows-field on a treeless highland; foreground shin-high blackthorn scrub, frost-silvered spider-web sheets between branches, a mossy standing-stone leaning seaward; midground dozens of barrow-mounds ridge the plateau, each crowned with a split capstone, dead bracken pooled in the hollows; deep distance a stone circle breaks the horizon-line, its tallest monolith silhouetted against a violet storm-glow; sky lowering cloud-ceiling, moon invisible but its diffuse glow pressing silver through the cloud from above.

ICE-RIMED CASTLE — WINTER PASS — a Gothic castle half-buried in avalanche-deposited snow on a mountain-pass; foreground deep drifted snow, iron fence-spikes protruding at intervals, the road buried beneath three feet; midground the castle's outer-ward walls rise from the snowfield, icicle formations hanging from every corbel, every window dark; deep distance the castle's central keep towers over the pass, a single candle-amber lit window in the highest chamber; sky heavy slate-grey snow-cloud, pale silver moon-glow diffusing through, distant eagle-silhouette circling the north turret.

ASHENMERE DEAD-WOOD — petrified forest consumed by centuries of silence; foreground bark-cracked roots erupting through violet-veined soil, ghost-lichen glowing pale green between exposed stone; midground skeletal canopy of ten-thousand limbless spires interlocking overhead like ribcage vaulting, will-o-wisps drifting amber between trunks at chest height; deep distance a collapsed watchtower dissolving into black fog a mile off; sky pewter cloud-mass bleeding silver at the crown, single crow-flock wheeling.

VARHOLME NECROPOLIS — vast above-ground crypt-city sprawling across a sunken valley floor; foreground cracked marble tomb-lids tilted at collapse-angles, tufts of black heather splitting the joins, a single iron funerary lantern still burning candle-amber; midground mausoleum avenues receding in perfect grim symmetry, ornamental iron gates rusted to lace, moss-bearded obelisks listing under their own weight; deep distance a cathedral-tomb the size of a cathedral, its dome broken open to the sky; sky violet dusk.

VELDRATH CASTLE APPROACH — mountain-pass road ascending toward a cliff-top citadel whose spires pierce the cloud-ceiling; foreground shattered flagstone causeway edged with iron funeral-post lanterns dark and cold, dead ivy ropework across every surface; midground the valley walls pressing close, sheer chalk-black cliffs streaked bone-white, a stone aqueduct leaping the gorge far above; deep distance the citadel silhouette enormous and ink-black against pale moonlit cloud, its highest tower lost in mist; sky silver corona above the peak.

SILTMOOR CURSED-FEN — rolling fog-drowned lowland heath at the estuary edge; foreground waterlogged black peat cracked into polygon plates, pale sedge-grass catching silver light at blade-tips, iron grave-markers half-sunk and listing; midground heather waste fading to grey-green, low thorn-scrub silhouettes, wisps of white mist curling knee-high in long slow rivers; deep distance an abbey ruin rising on the only dry ridge, its single intact spire a black needle; sky bruised violet, thunderhead building.

DROSSFALL VOLCANIC PLAIN — cracked obsidian waste surrounding a dead volcanic caldera; foreground shattered basalt slabs warm underfoot, thin witch-fire vents exhaling pale-green gas through fissures, ash-dust drifting in slow spirals; midground a ruined city half-buried under grey pumice fall, broken arches and toppled bell-towers emerging from the debris field; deep distance the crater-wall itself, an immense black cirque, distant caldera-glow visible only as a cold green pulse at the rim; sky ash-grey blotting all stars.

GRIMTIDE COASTAL CLIFF — storm-wracked sea-cliff above a black-water fjord; foreground cliff-edge rock split into fissures, salt-bleached timber wreckage lodged in crevices, dark-green sea-moss slick across every ledge; midground the cliff-face dropping a full thousand feet in a single sheer plunge to boiling surf below, a ruined lighthouse-tower perched at the headland its lantern-room dark and hollow; deep distance the fjord mouth lost in silver sea-fog, a drowning village foreshore just visible; sky storm-green, lightning silhouetting distant stacks.

UMBRAL CEMETERY-MOOR — endless flat grave-field merging without boundary into open heathland; foreground cracked limestone headstones at crazy angles, black heather pushing through every joint, fox-fire pooling in the low hollows; midground rows of tombs stretching miles in every direction, the geometry dissolving into haze, a lone yew tree in the far middle-distance enormous against pale sky; deep distance a low fortified wall marks the necropolis boundary, a squat gatehouse barely visible; sky full pale moon haloed in violet ice-ring, bat-silhouettes orbiting.

CHORRATH ABBEY RUIN — collapsed Benedictine-scale abbey under open moonlit sky; foreground nave floor exposed, paving stones split by root-heave, broken choir-stall timber collapsed and silver-weathered; midground the remaining arcade piers standing in broken rows, their arches interrupted mid-span, moonlight falling in column-shafts through the roofless shell, pale-green moss mapping every stone-course; deep distance the crossing tower still intact and enormous, its four lancet windows dark as eye-sockets; sky clear cold indigo, moon directly overhead, single owl-silhouette on the tower crown.

DREADMARCH FORTIFIED-BRIDGE — stone fortified bridge spanning a gorge-canyon a hundred meters wide and five hundred deep; foreground the bridge deck cracked and heaved, iron-spiked parapets warped by heat long past, candle-amber lanterns in iron cages still burning at intervals; midground the gorge walls visible plunging into fog below, ancient stone aqueduct piers emerging from the canyon-side at mid-height; deep distance the far gate-tower at the bridge-end, massive, its portcullis raised but dark within; sky overcast deep violet, wind-torn cloud moving fast.

BLACKWATER SWAMP — half-submerged gothic ruin in poisoned black-water fen; foreground water surface still as obsidian, reflections of dead cypress trunks perfectly inverted, a sunken iron cross tilted at forty-five degrees; midground dead-tree spires rising from the water in loose cathedral-column arrangements, will-o-wisps burning cold pale-green above the surface, submerged chapel-arch visible a foot below the waterline; deep distance a larger ruin-mass, a drowned manor, its roof-ridge above water level, windows dark; sky deep teal dusk, single heron-silhouette crossing.

CORVENMOUNT ALPINE PASS — high-mountain snow-pass between two black granite peaks, a vampire citadel at the far end; foreground wind-scoured snow packed between exposed rock, dead pine trunks snapped at mid-height and ice-rimed silver-grey; midground the pass road dropping and rising across a series of saddle-ridges, desolate and bare, wrought-iron waymarker crosses at each turn; deep distance the citadel enormous at the pass-end, its towers jagged against the glacial sky, lit windows like amber sparks at impossible height; sky pale ice-blue, clouds shredding on the peaks.

HOLLOWFEN DROWNED-VILLAGE — abandoned village foreshore half-swallowed by rising fenwater; foreground cobblestones dissolving into black mud at the waterline, a submerged market-cross visible through still brown water, dead reeds in dense thickets along the margin; midground village rooftops emerging from the water-surface, chimneys intact, red-tile sagging, a church-tower standing clear with its clock frozen; deep distance the open fen stretching to the horizon, a distant mill-tower standing alone; sky orange-bruised dusk, starling-murmurations over the tower.

MALDWYCH HEATHER-MOOR — vast wind-swept moorland under a twilight sky of impossible depth; foreground dark heather mat, bog-cotton tufts white as bone, exposed peat-bank edge cut sheer and black; midground the moor rolling in long swells to the horizon in every direction, barrow-mounds rising at intervals like sleeping creatures, a ruined standing-stone circle at the crest of the near ridge; deep distance an abbey silhouette on the far ridge, its silhouette broken but unmistakable; sky deep violet fading to amber at the horizon-line, a single wolf-silhouette on the ridge.

VORRENMAW CANYON GORGE — red-sandstone canyon gorge with a roman-scale aqueduct bridging the chasm; foreground canyon rim edge, loose sandstone flaking away underfoot, iron-red dust on every surface, thornbush roots gripping crack-lines; midground the gorge dropping three hundred meters to a black river below, the aqueduct spanning it on enormous piers, its arches intact but encrusted with black and ochre mineral staining; deep distance a cathedral ruin built directly into the far canyon wall, its apse window facing the void; sky stormy amber, lightning below cloud.

FELLCROFT CURSED VILLAGE — aerial view of an abandoned hill-village under building storm; foreground mossy rooftops immediately below the viewpoint, cracked chimney-stacks, a collapsed barn-roof exposing black timber ribbing; midground the village lane-network visible from above, empty of all movement, a village well in the central square, one window of an inn showing candle-amber light; deep distance the castle on the ridge above the village immense and absolute, its full silhouette dominating the upper half of the composition; sky thunderhead purple-green, lightning branching.

OSSUARY PLAIN — catacomb-entrance necropolis spreading across open limestone karst; foreground the karst surface pitted and pocked, iron-grille catacomb entrances set flush at intervals, grave-offerings of black iron scattered between; midground the plain extending to the limit of vision, hundreds of entrance-grilles and monument-stones, pale limestone turning blue-grey in the failing light, a central ossuary-chapel the largest structure; deep distance a cliff-escarpment at the plain's far edge, black and vertical, its face carved with enormous relief-work barely readable; sky moonlit silver-white, high cirrus.

SALTMERE DROWNING COAST — gothic fishing-village foreshore at the edge of coastal cliff collapse; foreground collapsed cobble street ending in a sheer cliff-drop, a ruined harbour-wall with iron mooring rings still bolted in place, salt-grass in the cracks; midground the sea directly below crashing against half-submerged building-foundations, the village church perched at the cliff-edge, its graveyard half-fallen into the sea; deep distance the headland curving away revealing open ocean, dark and silver, a lighthouse-tower on the far point dark; sky sea-grey, a gannet-flock circling the tower.

THORNWALL DEAD-FOREST — ancient blackthorn forest grown to cathedral proportions; foreground root-mass at path-edge, thorns the length of fingers, bark cracked and silver-black, fallen branches webbed with white filament-fungi; midground the forest interior, thorn-canopy interlocking overhead into near-solid ceiling, allowing moonlight in narrow silver fractures, the trunks enormous at the base and then branching into insane complexity above; deep distance a ruined estate gatehouse consumed by thorn-mass, its pillars still upright within the growth; sky barely visible, fragments of moonlit violet between thorn-gaps, bats crossing.

VETHARA FROZEN LAKE — vast frozen lake foreground, gothic chateau on the far shore; foreground ice-surface cracked in long pressure-seam fractures, catching moonlight in blue-white arcs, dead reeds frozen upright along the near shore; midground the lake stretching wide, ice-surface perfect flat mirror under moonlight, a fog-layer six inches deep drifting across it; deep distance the chateau enormous on the far shore, its mansard-roof snow-piled, its windows dark except for one tower showing pale amber candlelight; sky full moon, cold silver, halo visible, single crow crossing.

CREMORNE VOLCANIC RUIN — ash-fall ruined city surrounding a smoldering fissure-field; foreground thick grey ash on every horizontal surface, collapsed columns half-buried in pumice, witch-fire vents exhaling lime-green gas through floor-cracks; midground ruined city blocks in various states of burial, roof-lines at different heights above the ash-field, a cathedral facade still standing but its interior gutted and ash-filled; deep distance the volcanic peak itself, immense, its summit lost in dense grey cloud, a faint red-orange glow at the crater-edge as accent only; sky ash and sulphur.

WYCHFALL CORPSE-MARSH — poisoned-fen at twilight ringed by dead-tree spires; foreground black water pooling in hoof-shaped depressions, sphagnum moss at the margin green-gold and unsettling, gas-bubbles breaking the surface in slow clusters; midground dead alder-tree spires rising from the water in irregular rows, bark stripped and pale, will-o-wisps burning cold blue-green between them, a sinking stone causeway just at water-level; deep distance a monastery-ruin on a raised island, its tower intact and enormous; sky deep teal, single pale moon, bats crossing low.

KRAUSS MOUNTAIN FORTRESS — cliff-face citadel clinging to a vertical basalt escarpment above a valley; foreground valley-floor looking up, loose scree and dead grass, iron pilgrimage-markers driven into the slope; midground the escarpment face vertical and immense, the fortress buildings embedded directly into the rock-face at multiple levels connected by external stairs and iron bridges; deep distance the highest tower cluster above the clifftop edge, spires against cloud, the very summit lost in mist; sky overcast grey-violet, a single bird of prey riding the updraft above.

BARROWMEAD GRAVE-FIELDS — ancient barrow-field stretching to the horizon under storm-purple sky; foreground the nearest barrow-mound close enough to read its grass-and-stone surface, iron votive spikes driven in rows along the crown, lichen in silver-and-black patches; midground a hundred barrow-mounds rolling away across the meadow, their spacing irregular, some clustered like sleeping giants, some in solitary isolation; deep distance a stone circle on the far hill-crest, its uprights black against lit sky; sky full storm-purple, lightning branching behind the stones.

DOLMENVAST ABBEY COURTYARD — roofless abbey courtyard open to sky, broken statuary throughout; foreground courtyard paving cracked and heaved, carved stone fragments face-down in the grass, a dry fountain basin filled with black leaf-litter; midground the courtyard walls intact at full height, lancet-arched niches empty of their figures, moonlight casting clean shadow-geometry across the grass, a stone processional cross at the centre broken at the shaft; deep distance the abbey church beyond the courtyard wall, its west facade enormous; sky indigo, full moon directly aligned, single silent owl.

STYGMERE DROWNED CHAPEL — black-water bog with gothic chapel ruin half-submerged at centre; foreground the bog-margin, peat and water meeting in a slow seam, dead reeds bunched and rattling, water surface showing sky-reflection in cold silver; midground the chapel ruin rising from the water, nave walls to window-height, lancet windows frameless, the water inside at same level as outside, a stone rood-screen still upright within; deep distance the bog stretching to reedy horizon, a single dead oak enormous on the far bank; sky first stars in deep blue, a bat-silhouette looping.

BLIGHTED FOREST — petrified dead-wood cathedral; foreground bone-pale root tangles erupting from black soil, crow feathers caught in cracked bark fissures; midground skeletal canopy arches sixty feet overhead, will-o-wisp clusters drifting between hollow trunks like slow green exhalations; deep distance a collapsed bell-tower visible through the lattice of dead branches, its crown swallowed by fog; sky bruised violet with a pale silver moon bleeding cold light through fingerbone twigs.
